description: The file defines a set of REST API endpoints for managing notes, using FastAPI framework. It includes routes for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting notes, with appropriate response models, error handling, and dependency injection for the service layer.

methods.name: List[Note] list_notes(service: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service))
methods.description: Endpoint to list all notes, returning a list of Note objects.

methods.name: Note create_note(payload: NoteCreate, service: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service))
methods.description: Endpoint to create a new note with provided data.

methods.name: Note get_note( note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="ID of the note to retrieve"), service: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service), )
methods.description: Retrieve a specific note by its ID.

methods.name: Note update_note( payload: NoteUpdate, note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="ID of the note to update"), service: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service), )
methods.description: Update an existing note by its ID with provided data.

methods.name: Response delete_note( note_id: int = Path(..., ge=1, description="ID of the note to delete"), service: NotesService = Depends(get_notes_service), )
methods.description: Delete a note by its ID, returning a 204 status on success.
